component.name: ELDRINTH
component.summary: Explore a dark fantasy world and uncover the Unbound Spire

description.p: A lone wayfarer seeks nine Anima Shards across four connected frontier regions. Explore authored fortresses, investigate lost records, and decide the fate of the people carried inside the Spire.
Play offline with keyboard, touch, or a standard gamepad. Three save slots, portable backups, adjustable difficulty, and display and sound preferences support your pilgrimage.
Contains mature themes of institutional violence and death. A content notice appears before first play.

Graphical overhaul with multi-clip animations, distinct regional wardens, 47-tile Blob Wang autotiling, regional master palettes, civic halls, bespoke shard fortresses, and regional landscape banners.
Regional warden tactics, remappable controls, gamepad support, portable save backups, and improved Linux desktop reliability.
